_about: SHELF of the historians of Muslim India in English before 1931: Elliot and Dowson's History of India as Told by its Own Historians (8 vols, Trübner, 1867-77), extracts from some 150 Persian and Arabic chronicles, and John Briggs's complete Ferishta, History of the Rise of the Mahomedan Power in India (4 vols, Longman, 1829). The Mughal court histories (Akbarnama, Ain-i-Akbari, Jahangir, Humayun) are on mughal-histories. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only; the 1971 and 1981 reprints of Briggs are not used. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 70); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
